import os
import re
import secrets
import select
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

qemu, firmware, disk, script = sys.argv[1:]
image = "file=" + disk + ",format=raw,snapshot=on,if=virtio"
args = [qemu, "-display", "none", "-serial", "stdio", "-monitor", "none",
        "-L", firmware, "-machine", "pc,accel=tcg", "-m", "512",
        "-nic", "none", "-device", "e1000", "-no-reboot", "-drive", image]
history = bytearray()
pending = bytearray()
terminal_controls = re.compile(rb"\x1b(?:\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]|\][^\x07]*\x07|[@-Z\\-_])")
secret = ("Test-Only-" + secrets.token_hex(12) + "2").encode()

def clean(value):
    return terminal_controls.sub(b"", bytes(value)).replace(b"\r", b"").replace(b"\x00", b"").replace(secret, b"<ephemeral>")

with subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT) as machine:
    def send(value):
        machine.stdin.write(value + b"\r\n")
        machine.stdin.flush()

    def expect(choices, seconds):
        end = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < end:
            text = clean(pending)
            for index, pattern in enumerate(choices):
                if re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE):
                    pending.clear()
                    return index
            ready, _, _ = select.select([machine.stdout], [], [], min(0.5, end - time.monotonic()))
            if not ready:
                if machine.poll() is None:
                    continue
                break
            block = os.read(machine.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
            if not block:
                break
            pending.extend(block)
            history.extend(block)
        raise RuntimeError("Expected serial response: " + str(choices))

    try:
        expect([rb"MikroTik Login:|login:"], 50)
        send(b"admin")
        expect([rb"password:"], 10)
        send(b"")
        prompt = rb"\[admin@[^\]]+\]\s*>\s*$"
        result = expect([prompt, rb"do you want to see the software license", rb"new password\s*[:>]"], 20)
        if result == 1:
            send(b"n")
            result = expect([prompt, rb"new password\s*[:>]"], 15)
            if result == 1: result = 2
        if result == 2:
            send(secret)
            expect([rb"(?:repeat|retype|confirm)[^:>\n]*[:>]"], 12)
            send(secret)
            expect([prompt], 15)

        data = Path(script).read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
        encoded = (data.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
                       .replace("$", "\\$").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n"))
        send((':do { :local code [:parse "' + encoded + '"]; $code }').encode())
        expect([rb"(?:^|\n)Hello, World!(?:\n|$)"], 12)
        print("RouterOS console readback: Hello, World!")
    finally:
        print(clean(history).decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        machine.terminate()
        try:
            machine.wait(4)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            machine.kill()
            machine.wait()
